name: Teen Docent Program, Los Altos History Museum
what_you_do: Teen docents work with museum staff, lead tours of the exhibits and the J. Gilbert Smith House, greet visitors and help at special events. They also take on leadership roles.
grades: High school student enrolled in the 2026-27 academic year
who_can_apply: High school students enrolled in the 2026-27 academic year.
pay_detail: Not stated on the current page. A 2024 article describes volunteer hours and work experience.
duration: August 2026 through June 2027, at least 4 hours per month. Two-day training on August 8 and 9 for accepted applicants.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026-27 are closed (the page says the deadline for this year has passed). The museum says to check back next spring for the 2027-28 year.
how_to_apply: Online Teen Docent Program application, linked from the museum site (closed for 2026-27). A 2024 article says selected applicants are called in for a brief interview.
notes: Phone 650.948.9427; the page gives no email address. Pay is not stated on the current official page, so paid_type is a judgment based on the 2024 article and should be confirmed. The lahstalon.org article is a 2024 news piece, used only for the interview and volunteer details. The museum's adult docent roles are separate and not for teens.
